difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the behaviour of the delta-dimension under flat morphisms of relative dimension r at source lines 1148-1161, label lemma-flat-inverse-image-dimension, whose proof occupies source lines 1163-1191. The proof reduces the statement about an arbitrary closed subset to the case of an irreducible component of the preimage of an integral closed subspace, which is the only case with content, and then does three things: it uses that the morphism is locally of finite presentation to obtain openness and hence dominance of the component over the base, it places the generic points in the schematic loci so that the local ring at the generic point of the source has dimension zero, and it applies the fibre dimension formula to identify the transcendence degree of the residue field extension with r, which is exactly the required shift of delta-dimensions. The counted statement records neither the reduction nor the dimension computation.
